title: Future undersea power cable to connect PH, Malaysia - Marcos

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday announced that an undersea power cable will soon connect Malaysia and the Philippines, the first such project within the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).

"I am happy to report that the first undersea cable for sharing of energy is going to be laid between Malaysia, Sabah in particular, and Philippines, in Mindanao," Marcos said during a press briefing following the culmination of the 49th ASEAN Summit.
"And this is the first undersea cable as well. So, the beginnings that were on land are now extending into the sea," he added.
The Department of Energy said the enhanced memorandum of understanding on the ASEAN Power Grid (APG) will allow the Philippines to obtain power supply from its Southeast Asian neighbors.
The memorandum was signed last November 15 as the Philippines hosted the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
Manila has passed the ASEAN chairmanship to Singapore, which will lead the international conferences in 2027. —RF, GMA News
